components.name: Domed gate pylon
components.function: Need tower/arch springing modules, gate-to-quay/bridge threshold and dome seats. Existing open screens, gold roof and harbor lamp language reused; mirrored tower count/hidden third group requires parity review. Coastal shrubs/grass, seabirds/moths and fish below quay proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated domed gate pylon matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
